content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service provided by GitHub that allows users to host custom domains and websites. When used in conjunction with NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, it becomes a robust digital product store that operates independently of traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. This setup enables creators to sell digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates, without incurring platform fees or losing control over their sales data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this digital product store is built on a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery. Here's how it works: when a customer purchases a product, the payment is processed by NOWPayments, which sends a webhook notification to the Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend. This backend then triggers the automated delivery of the digital product to the customer, eliminating the need for manual intervention or third-party intermediaries.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure setup is specifically designed for digital creators who want to sell their products without relying on traditional payment processors. Whether you're an ebook author, a course creator, or a template designer, this setup provides a low-cost, high-performance alternative to traditional digital product marketplaces. By using GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can take control of your sales data and avoid platform fees like Gumroad's 10% charge.
By using GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can build a fully functional digital product store that operates independently of traditional payment processors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this digital product store work together include GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery. Additionally, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can be used for file delivery, and Supabase or Google Sheets can be used for order storage. By combining these components, creators can build a fully functional digital product store that operates independently of traditional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital product store using GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, follow these steps: first, sign up for a GitHub account and create a new repository for your digital product store. Next, set up a custom domain and configure your GitHub Pages settings. Then, integrate NOWPayments with your store and set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery. Finally, connect your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery and your Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Gumroad's 10% fee is a thing of the past with NOWPayments' 0.5% fee.

You can use NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that integrates with your digital product store and processes payments without incurring platform fees.
Can I use GitHub Pages for free hosting?
Yes, GitHub Pages offers free hosting for custom domains and websites, making it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to host their own digital product stores.
How do I automate delivery of digital products?
You can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery of digital products to customers, eliminating the need for manual intervention or third-party intermediaries.
Can I use Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage?
Yes, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets to store orders and customer data, providing a secure and scalable solution for managing sales data.
How do I connect my Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery?
You can connect your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to your digital product store and use it for file delivery, making it easy to distribute digital products to customers.
